preparation_and_method.selected_state: Optimized rigid PUR foams produced as larger molded samples.
mixing: Polyol-component ingredients except the physical blowing agent were mixed for approximately 2 minutes at 2000 rpm.
Opteon 1100 was added last to the polyol component and mixed for approximately 1 minute.
pMDI was added and mixed for 10 seconds.
For the optimized larger samples, the reaction mixture was poured into a 30 by 30 by 10 cm mold.
preparation_and_method.conditioning: Samples cured for 24 hours at room temperature before additional testing.

condition_limits: Mold dimensions are not density-specimen dimensions.
Room-temperature curing is not a stated density-test temperature and must not be converted into an invented numerical test temperature.
Three cup-test specimens per formulation and 81 cup-test specimens per series do not establish density n for the selected optimized larger foams.
The six compression specimens and the TGA replicate count do not establish density n.
Thermal-conductivity test temperatures and polyol-rheometry conditions do not establish density-test conditions.
The 45 kg/m^3 optimization target is not a selected density measurement.
The 40 kg/m^3 compression-normalization density is not a selected density measurement.
No compression modulus, thermal conductivity, or other property is selected by this review.
